name: Make Integration
description: Integrate with the Make.as newsletter service (subscribe users).
project_description:
Make Integration 
 This module integrates Drupal with the Norwegian Make newsletter and SMS service.

 Currently we only support newsletter integration. feel free to contribute or sponsor if you'd like to see the SMS integration as well.

 Installation & Configuration 
 1. Enable the module.

2. Go to Make Integrations & API page and get yourself the User ID and API Key .

3. Navigate to /admin/config/services/make to configure the module.

4. Update your configuration with the User ID and API Key and hit save to authenticate first.

5. Once saved, you can select the preferred subscriber list you want to use.

6. Optionally you can configure which fields should be enabled in the subscription form.

7. Place the " Make Signup Block " to add the subscription form to your site.

 Usage 
 Use the " Make Signup Block " to add the subscription form to your site.

 Roadmap
